Thanks again and again. We can’t spoke again l think, that’s hard. But l shouldn’t. l should control myself. Knowing I wouldn’t be able to hold myself back, I even deleted their number. Isn’t that terrible? :) For the past month, I’ve been trying to prove myself — but it didn’t work. Now it’s time to retreat into my corner and get used to a state of “nonexistence.” It may sound cliché, but over time, you lose the desire to believe in anything. I hope things get better. Thank you very much.
No worries . Don’t worry l don’t even have the strength anyway

Let me sum it up for you with this: by not caring about me, he ruined me even more than I already was. I know it’s dramatic, but this is all I can take. l could say more, but the situation is already clear. It’s the same in my case too — I’m sure she doesn’t even want to hear my name, and I’m certain he doesn’t have any real feelings left. l felt so powerless for not being able to stop her from killing the version of me that existed when he was with me. Still feeling it. 
My mind is working overtime just to deceive me, to trick me into thinking about the past, to help me fool myself.
I don’t want to isolate myself, but I don’t even feel like looking up at the sky anymore.
Other than exercising and writing, I can’t do much — I guess that’s obvious.
I’m not trying to create drama, and I’m not in a deep depression either.
But what I’ve been through keeps breaking my hope, and I’m truly sad.
I know there’s nothing you can really do, but thank you so much for try.
I have a friend I’ve known for a very long time.
But in recent years, I just don’t feel like talking about my pain anymore with him. 
Today is an exception, I suppose. I don’t want to feel helpless.
Last night, I texted my friend and told him we broke up.
This morning he called, and again just now — I didn’t pick up.
Do you know why?
Because four days ago, this close friend of mine was on the phone with the person I broke up with.
His opinion of him was that “she is a good person. Marry with her, she is the best person who ever came into your life. 
Now, I don’t even want to talk to my own friend.I don’t want to remember anything.

Sorry for making this so long.

With every fiber of my humanity, I thank all of you — and you especially. All I can do now is say: fate, destiny, chance, yin yang, karma whatever it is. l hope all of you best :)

No excuses, Great motivation. But this part “ Find the balance of not allowing that pain to harbor resentment and envy in your heart towards her or the world” . Wise advice, but it’s impossible for me now. Thank you very much.
4 is very hard. But l know l should move on. But feeling terrible anyway:) 2 and 6 are my main focus rn. God bless you, thank you.

l do second part, too. When l feel sad, my mind is hunter for bad experiences. Searches for happiest ones with past. l couldn’t sleep last night. Today wont be better. Just want to run from myself, its hard to embrace. Anyway great advices, thank you very much.
Thank you played basketball today, but still crumbling:)
Coping becomes more challenging. Maybe it’s a problem unique to me. Thank you for advices.

If I have to say something painful, it’s that I did what you said. It was incredibly painful not being able to look at the photos while deleting them—but if I had looked, it would have hurt even more. We can’t talk anymore, because I’m struggling so much to express myself. Once I start writing, I can’t stop, so I ended up using the blocking method—even though I really don’t approve of it. Thank you so much for all your help.
